sites.name: Echo Lake
sites.about: Echo Lake is a semi-developed, dispersed camping area at the shoreline of Echo Lake near the Caribou Wilderness. A vault toilet is on site, as well as trash recepticals. Echo Lake is a popular place for kayaks and conoes. Be aware that this area was damaged in the 2021 Dixie Fire and hazards still…

sites.name: Silver Bowl Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $12 per night
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from a hand pump
sites.about: Located near the shores of Silver Lake, near the Caribou Wilderness, Silver Bowl is a developed campground with 18 designated sites. A tall mixed conifer forest overhead, and beautiful pine mat manzanita below, this is an out of the way (yet not too far away) escape from the world. Caribou…
sites.directions: From county road A21, take Silver Lake road until you reach Silver Lake.

sites.name: Bogard Campground
sites.feeText: No fees are required for this site
sites.hours: Quiet hours are 10:00 p.m. until 6:00 a.m.
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from a hand pump
sites.about: Quiet and tucked away from the beaten path. Pine creek adjacent to campground, beautiful aspens in and around campground. Located 1.75 miles off Highway 44. No Fees. 10 sites. Hand pumped water. Vault toilets, Maximum trailer length 25 feet.

sites.name: Warner Creek
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $10 per night
sites.about: Warner Creek Campground is a hidden gem, nestled in a mixed conifer forest. Only 15 minutes from Chester, this semi-developed campgroiund offers plenty of shade, and fresh air. 10 sites are available, each with a picnic table and fire rings. No potable water on site.
sites.directions: From Chester, take Feather River Drive about 1 mile, then turn Left onto Chester Warner Valley Road. Drive almost 7 miles. Warner Creek Campground will be on the right,.
sites.restrictions: Include: campfires in fire rings only, all animals must be on a managed six (6) foot leash, quiet hours from 10pm to 6 am, no fireworks, must occupy site first night, and every night thereafter.

sites.name: High Bridge Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $14 per night
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from a hand pump
sites.about: High Bridge Campground is situated where Warner Creek meets the Feather River. It is a developed campground with 12 available sites. The campgroud was heavily damaged by the 2021 Dixie Fire, and will rewmain closed until further notice.
sites.directions: From Chester, travel north on Feather River Drive for about a mile. Turn LEFT onto Chester Warner Valley Rd. Drive about 5 miles. High Bridge Campground is on the LEFT.
sites.restrictions: Include: campfires in fire rings only, all animals must be on a managed six (6) foot leash, quiet hours from 10pm to 6 am, no fireworks, must occupy site first night, and every night thereafter.
